title: They're ok
text:
They're ok. A little flexible and flimsy compared to my metal whisk, but oh well. They come with two sizes though the "smaller" one isn't actually much smaller than the big one. They're cute, I suppose. A little irksome to clean, but overall if you want something cheap and cute they're not bad to get. If they were $10 or higher I probably would not have gotten them.

Update: In Nov or Dec 2013 the one I use just fell apart. Oh well. I had given the other one to my sister and I don't know what condition it's in or how often she uses it at this point.
